targetReport.title: 中华人民共和国预算法 (Budget Law of the People's Republic of China)
targetReport.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the National People's Congress)
targetReport.description: China's foundational budget statute, and the hub of this entire slice -- four separate documents in this corpus cite it by name in operative voice, which is what promotes it from BRICS/G.1's `deferred` note to a node. Enactment and amendment history, verbatim from the NPC's own page header: 「（1994年3月22日第八届全国人民代表大会第二次会议通过　根据2014年8月31日第十二届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国预算法〉的决定》第一次修正　根据2018年12月29日第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第七次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国产品质量法〉等五部法律的决定》第二次修正）」. Commencement, 第一百零一条: 「本法自1995年1月1日起施行。1991年10月21日国务院发布的《国家预算管理条例》同时废止。」 The transfer-payment article, 第十六条, quoted in full because it is the statutory basis the whole Chinese fiscal-transfer chain rests on: 「国家实行财政转移支付制度。财政转移支付应当规范、公平、公开，以推进地区间基本公共服务均等化为主要目标。财政转移支付包括中央对地方的转移支付和地方上级政府对下级政府的转移支付，以为均衡地区间基本财力、由下级政府统筹安排使用的一般性转移支付为主体。按照法律、行政法规和国务院的规定可以设立专项转移支付，用于办理特定事项。建立健全专项转移支付定期评估和退出机制。市场竞争机制能够有效调节的事项不得设立专项转移支付。上级政府在安排专项转移支付时，不得要求下级政府承担配套资金。但是，按照国务院的规定应当由上下级政府共同承担的事项除外。」 ("The State implements a fiscal transfer payment system … with equalisation of basic public services across regions as the principal objective … with general transfer payments — used to equalise basic fiscal capacity across regions and arranged at the discretion of the lower-level government — as the main body…"). Also load-bearing for the central/local architecture, 第六条: 「中央一般公共预算包括中央各部门（含直属单位，下同）的预算和中央对地方的税收返还、转移支付预算。…中央一般公共预算支出包括中央本级支出、中央对地方的税收返还和转移支付。」 Fetched TIER A over plain HTTP from the NPC's own portal (HTTPS fails on that host with a ClientHello rejection -- see `_note`); completeness verified by confirming the extracted text runs from 第一条 through 第一百零一条, all 101 articles across 11 chapters.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing statute, amended rather than reissued (enacted 1994, first amended 2014, second amended 2018) -- the same convention this corpus applies to statutes elsewhere, e.g. `br-lc-62-1989` and `ru-subsistence-minimum-law-134fz`.

targetReport.title: Consumer Price Index (Ethiopian Statistics Services)
targetReport.description: Ethiopia's official monthly CPI, produced by ESS (formerly the Central Statistical Agency/CSA). VERIFIED DIRECTLY this session via ESS's own site: 'Published monthly', described as 'the principal measure of inflation'; ESS's own framing states its statistics 'support evidence-based policy decisions, wage and income adjustments, business planning, and economic research'. Confirmed via Grok's round: Ethiopia is on the IMF's e-GDDS dissemination tier (not full SDDS), per the IMF's own 2019 press release announcing Ethiopia's e-GDDS implementation -- the same weaker tier already found for Kenya, now a second country on this node. Also confirmed: Ethiopia is NOT bound by the East African Community's binding Harmonised CPI regulations (found for Kenya) -- Ethiopia is a geographic neighbour of EAC members but not a Partner State subject to that specific instrument, per Grok's search. COICOP classification is referenced in an older (2013) CSA methodological note as 'COICOP... with few exceptions' but not minted as an edge -- see _open_questions.

targetReport.title: Basel Framework
targetReport.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Bank for International Settlements
targetReport.description: The consolidated international standard for bank capital, liquidity and risk measurement, maintained by the Basel Committee and published by the BIS. Not law anywhere; adopted into binding national rules by member jurisdictions, which is why national capital guidelines carry Basel paragraph numbers in their margins.
targetReport.cadence_note: Maintained as a living consolidated framework with dated amendments rather than issued editions. Filed as annual for the same reason SNA 2008 is — the enum has no bucket for a standard.

release_schedule.note: The Basel Framework is a continuously maintained online consolidated compilation of Basel Committee standards (bis.org/basel_framework/), not a periodic report. It is updated on a rolling basis whenever the Basel Committee finalizes new standards or amendments (e.g., individual chapters carry their own 'Version effective as of' dates, such as the cryptoasset exposures chapter SCO60 effective 1 January 2026). No fixed annual or periodic release calendar or stated rule for the whole document was found; BIS also maintains a 'time traveller' tool showing already-announced future effective dates for specific chapters, but this is not a fixed recurring publication schedule for the framework as a whole.

targetReport.title: Public Service Pension Plan (PSPP) Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) Methodology
targetReport.description: Formal formula for annual COLA applied to PSPP pensions in pay. Escalation factor is calculated from the average Statistics Canada Consumer Price Index over two consecutive 12-month periods ending 30 September. Maximum annual increase 8%; excess carried forward. Applied each January. Primary provincial mechanism that directly indexes a major compensation stream to CPI.

targetReport.title: System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008)
targetReport.publisher: United Nations, European Commission, IMF, OECD and World Bank
targetReport.description: The internationally agreed standard set of concepts, definitions, classifications and accounting rules for compiling national accounts, in force 2008-2025. Superseded by the 2025 SNA (UNSC 56th Session, March 2025) — see sna-2025. Retained here because the eight reports below still cite it by name as their methodology basis; country-level rollout of the successor targets 2029-2030, so nothing downstream is factually wrong yet.
targetReport.cadence_note: Revised roughly once a generation — previous editions 1953, 1968 and 1993. Not an annual release; releases_per_year is nominal so the pulse rate reads as near-static.

release_schedule.note: Superseded by the 2025 SNA (UNSC 56th Session, March 2025) — see sna-2025's own published-calendar schedule for the adoption date and rollout window. No further revisions expected under the SNA 2008 edition.

results.bestSpan: El SCNPY está ajustado a los estándares internacionales vigentes y que están compilados en el Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales del 2008 (SCN 2008), que proporciona los lineamientos estadísticos para la elaboración de un conjunto completo, coherente y flexible de cuentas macroeconómicas
results.window: 82, pone a disposición de los usuarios el documento “Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de Paraguay (SCNPY), Nuevo Periodo base año 2014, Metodología”, en el cual se presentan los aspectos metodológicos, las fuentes de información y los resultados obtenidos del proceso de implementación del cambio de año base de las cuentas nacionales anuales. El SCNPY está ajustado a los estándares internacionales vigentes y que están compilados en el Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales del 2008 (SCN 2008), que proporciona los lineamientos estadísticos para la elaboración de un conjunto completo, coherente y fl exible de cuentas macroeconómicas para la formulación de políticas, el análisis y la investigación. El SCN 2008 fue preparado en forma conjunta por las Naciones Unidas, la Comisión Europea, la Organización de Cooperación y Desarrollo Económico, el Fondo Monetario Internacional y el Grupo del Banco Mundial.
